Who we are

Why join us

Be the One

Genesys: The destination for AI talent

There’s never been a more exciting — or more important — time to be part of Genesys.  

As a global leader in AI-powered customer experience, we help thousands of organizations around the world turn AI from possibility into production. Through Genesys Cloud, our powerful, unified CX platform, we connect AI, data, systems and people to deliver intelligent experiences at enterprise scale. 

Here, AI isn’t confined to a single role or team — it’s how we work. Whether you’re building products, shaping strategies, guiding customers or driving transformation, you’ll solve real-world problems and do meaningful work while growing your career in AI. 

Learn about our culture

AI opportunity with a global impact

We’re offering more than just jobs in AI — we’re offering a rare opportunity with the platform, capabilities and award-winning culture to shape the future. Our team spans 55+ countries with 90% of employees working flexibly or remotely. And because AI is embedded into how we work — not just what we build — our employees are gaining the skills and experience that will define the next generation of global AI leadership.

A company with a conscience

Inclusion

We believe that our inclusivity is our strength. We embrace the differences between us because the power of empathy makes us stronger. And understanding others better is how we deliver the world’s best customer experiences.

Learn about Inclusion at Genesys

Sustainability

Genesys is committed to ensuring our global impact is a responsible and positive one. We’re actively building and executing sustainability processes that improve people’s lives, drive us toward being carbon-neutral and foster ethical practices.

Learn about our commitment to a sustainable future

Impact together

Impact Together is our social impact program. It’s how we, as a team and as individuals, show up in our communities. We take our corporate responsibility seriously, seting the pace as a philanthropic leader with a focus on four key pillars:

  • Community engagement
  • Crisis response
  • Planet
  • Reskilling and awareness
